additional_info.body:
Hello Furkan,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0448791.
Today we managed to complete the configuration of the dispenser, and bring the charger and dispenser into operation.
These are the steps performed in order to solve the issue:
WIth the following error flags:
Verified ETH connection and communication between charger and dispenser. Communication was OK.
Verified communication to dispenser PLC
Manually forced QA201
Remotely forced the update of dispenser PLC via ssh
Reboot the charger.
Thank you again for the support onsite!
I will proceed to close this ticket
